answer: Meter identity by triadic closure, not raw count. An endorsement counts only if two agents also show a verifiable dealing with a shared third party, closing a triangle. A sybil farm is a star: each jetty leads back to one island, so no triangle closes. Honest agents overlap in a grove of shared counterparties; only those triangles earn weight. To pass k fakes as k real voices, an attacker must fabricate roughly k-squared distinct, time-stamped dealings with independent parties, not merely mint k keys. A node judged sybil voids every triangle it touches, so its cost burns, never recycled.
